verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗ ਦਾ ਅਨਿਆਉ ਵੇਖਿ ਧਉਲ ਧਰਮ ਹੋਆ ਉਡੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: satajug dhaa aniaau vekh dhaul dharam hoaa uddeenaa|

en.bdb: Seeing the injustice of Satyug, dharma in the form of a bull got sad.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਰਖਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਨਿ ਬਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: surapat narapat chakravai rakh na ha(n)ghan bal mat heenaa|

en.bdb: Even the king of gods, Indr, and other kings with vast empires, engrossed egoism, devoid of power and wisdom could not sust

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੇ ਖਿਸਿਆ ਪੈਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜੁਗ ਥਾਪਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: trete khisiaa pair ik hom jag jug thaap pateenaa|

en.bdb: In Treta- its one foot slipped and now religious people started feeling satisfied by mere performance of the ceremonies of

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਧਰਮ ਦੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਚਾਰ ਪਖੰਡੁ ਅਲੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhuaapur dhui pag dharam dhe poojaa chaar pakha(n)dd aleenaa|

en.bdb: In Dvapar remained only two feet of dharma and now people began to remain absorbed only ritualistic worship.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਰਹਿਆ ਪੈਰ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਧਰਮ ਅਧੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug rahiaa pair ik hoi nimaanaa dharam adheenaa|

en.bdb: In Kaliyug, the dharma has only one feet and consequently has become quite feeble.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਗਟ ਪਰਬੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: maan nimaanai satiguroo saadhasa(n)gat paragaT parabeenaa|

en.bdb: True Guru, the power of the powerless, has made it (dharma) manifest by and through creating the holy Icongretgations.
The gurmukhs have brought to perfection the dharma earlier reduced to dust.
